node_01_dock.title: Orb Radiant Outpost 9
node_01_dock.description: The pressurized docking ring on the cluster's edge — GTA customs postings on one side, Xyd pilgrim hostels on the other, a cantina where Treaty law and black-market bounties trade at the same table. Beyond the airlock: open void, 100,000 stars, and the plasma-bird nesting ground.

node_02_customs.title: GTA Quarantine Air-Lock
node_02_customs.description: Inspector Kaelen Drake runs the manifest inspection. Cargo checks, Treaty compliance, a tariff ledger with your name in it. Get the manifest signed or find the bribe route.

node_03_void_breach.title: Depressurized Catwalk
node_03_void_breach.description: A hull breach exposes the catwalk to hard vacuum and cold radiation. The void is the enemy before the enemy — pass it, seal the breach, or be thrown back to the customs air-lock.

node_04_beacon_core.title: Cathedral Wayline Relay
node_04_beacon_core.description: An ancient pre-spaceflight navigational beacon, attuned to the World Gate. Vael-Xis the Grey reads its calibration like a tuning fork — the gate is real, and this beacon is the key to reaching it.

node_05_skiff_skirmish.title: Solar Siphon Run
node_05_skiff_skirmish.description: A privateer skiff intercepts you in open space — the corsair doctrine hunting GTA convoys. Twin plasma cannons vs your hypercore. The void crackles as the skirmish begins.

node_06_salvage_cache.title: Derelict Cargo Container
node_06_salvage_cache.description: A sealed freight module adrift in the outpost shadow — storm-scoured, humming with salvage. The skirmish won, the cache is yours to open.
